name: Dixon Technologies (India)

headline.text: Q1 FY27: revenue ₹15,548 cr (+21.1% YoY), PAT ₹718 cr (+156.4% YoY).

citations.section: Revenue Q1 FY27 not located on a page

headline.text: Trailing twelve months: revenue ₹51,585 cr, EBITDA ₹1,847 cr (3.6% margin), PAT ₹2,082 cr.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 49.9% a year over FY21–FY26 (₹6,448 cr → ₹48,873 cr).
FY26 revenue growth of 25.8% was within its 5-year range (14.0% to 119.7%).
EBITDA margin compressed by 42 bps over FY23–FY26 (4.3% → 3.8%).
PAT compounded at 59.4% a year over FY21–FY26, ahead of revenue.
Debt-to-equity was 0.21 at FY26 end (0.35 at FY23).
Borrowings rose 2.2× from ₹453 cr to ₹994 cr over FY23–FY26.
Over the last 5 years, operating cash flow was 1.22× reported profit (₹4,515 cr vs ₹3,697 cr) — profits are turning into cash.

citations.section: Operating cash flow FY26 not located on a page

claims.text: Free cash flow (as computed by screener.in) was positive in 4 of the last 5 years, ₹1,125 cr in total.
Capex over the last 5 years was ₹3,390 cr, 75% of operating cash flow (derived as operating cash flow − free cash flow).
Cash conversion cycle shortened from 2 to -7 days over FY23–FY26.
Return on capital employed was 29% in FY26 (24% in FY23).

overview.excerpt: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited (‘Dixon’, ‘The Company’ or ‘We’) is one of India’s leading Electronic Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers, delivering end-to- end manufacturing solutions to global and domestic brands.

We are an equal opportunity employer providing equal remuneration for women and men. These initiatives collectively reinforce a high-performance culture where employees feel valued, supported and motivated to contribute meaningfully to sustainable business growth. PARTICULARS OF EMPLOYEES AND REMUNERATION

Dixon Technologies (India) Limited_33rd AGM Notice 2025-26 52 cultivation in the industry, the company has grown into a world-leading provider of smart products and services, and has formed a full-category product layout covering smartphones, AI PCs, automotive electronics, tablets, smart watches/bands, smart glasses and more.
